title: Valencian International University Reportedly Required AI Facial Recognition for Online Exams in Spain Without a Viable Alternative
summary: Valencian International University in Spain reportedly required students to undergo continuous AI facial verification to take online exams. Spain's data protection authority reportedly found that students had no viable alternative and that the university processed their biometric data without a valid legal basis. It imposed fines totaling €650,000 for unlawful processing and excessive data collection.
